plan.notes: Hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official Case Western Reserve University General Bulletin (2026-27) Economics, BA 'Sample Plan of Study' grid (https://bulletin.case.edu/management/economics/economics-ba/, cross-checked against https://bulletin.case.edu/management/economics/economics-ba/economics-ba.pdf). Footnotes quoted from the plan: (a) Unified General Education Requirement; (b) 'Students considering additional coursework in mathematics (i.e. MATH 201, MATH 223, etc.) should take MATH 121 and MATH 122.'; (c) 'Students considering additional coursework in statistics should consider STAT 301 and STAT 302.'; (d) 'Not required for the major but highly suggested.' ANOMALY DISCLOSED: the official plan prints a 'MGMT 205 Essentials of Personal Finance or MGMT 206 Investing for Everyone' row (footnote d) in Year 3 Fall WITH NO credit hours, and the printed Year 3 Fall total of 15 excludes it (3+3+3+3+3); the same course choice appears in Year 4 Fall WITH 1.5 credits counted. Because its credit value in Year 3 Fall cannot be determined from the official document, that row is omitted from the structured plan and documented here instead of invented. REPEATED COURSE: the official plan places MGMT 395 Seminar (1 cr, footnote d) once in Year 4 Fall and twice in Year 4 Spring; allow_repeated_courses is set for this reason. 'Major Elective' and unlabeled slots are choice placeholders. Prerequisites are not printed in the sample plan, so prereq arrays are empty; prerequisites live in the bulletin's course descriptions.
